fixed_point.description: Homogeneous steady state (u*,v*) DECLARED by the requester. The Jacobian is the linearization there; the adapter does not verify either, and no measurement is involved.

band.record_inequality: D_v f_u + D_u g_v > 2 sqrt(D_u D_v det J)  <=>  S>0 and S^2 > 4 Du Dv det J

tail.rule: for q >= max(S,0)/(Du Dv): det = q(DuDv q - S) + det J >= det J > 0 and tr = tr J - (Du+Dv)q < 0
tail.scope: modes n=0..0 classified exactly one by one; every n>=1 (infinitely many) covered by the rule above
tail.lean: TuringScope.neumann_tail_hurwitz (parameterized in J, Du, Dv, p, s, n0)

conditions.condition: domain large compared with lambda_c (declared multiple)

wavelength.formula: k_c^2 = sqrt(det J/(Du Dv)); lambda_c = 2 pi/k_c (turing-wavelength record notation; evaluated in float)
